header.name: Workcenter History
header.description:
**Workcenter History**

This screen provides a detailed timeline of operational states, modes, and events for each workcenter, enabling visibility into equipment behavior and downtime analysis.

**Purpose:**

- Track every state change (e.g., Production, Idle, Disabled) and associated events (e.g., Maintenance, Setup, Faults).

- Support OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness) analysis by capturing availability and performance losses.

- Provide audit trails for compliance and continuous improvement.

**Key Features:**

- \*\*Historical Records:\*\* Displays start and end times, duration, workcenter, mode, state, event, work order, and schedule.

- \*\*Color-Coded Status:\*\* Modes and states use ISA-101 color standards for quick visual interpretation.

- \*\*Filtering & Search:\*\* Narrow results by date range, workcenter, work order, schedule, or mode. Advanced GraphQL filtering available for complex queries.

- \*\*Data Analysis Tools:\*\* Group, sort, and chart records to identify trends and root causes.

- \*\*Actions:\*\* Create new entries, edit existing records, delete, or refresh data. Each record includes notes and user attribution for traceability.

- \*\*Integration:\*\* Records can be created automatically via equipment signals or manually by operators.

This screen is essential for downtime tracking, shift performance comparison, and operational efficiency improvements.

fields.label: Code
fields.description: Unique identifier for this workcenter history record. Typically auto-generated but can be modified if your organization uses a specific naming convention. Must be unique across all workcenter history records.

fields.label: Occur At
fields.description: When did this operational state or event begin? Select the date and time. This is required for all records and is used to calculate duration and build operational timelines.

fields.label: End At
fields.description: When did this operational state or event end? Leave blank if the state is still ongoing. Setting this value will enable duration calculation and mark the state as closed.

fields.label: Workcenter
fields.description: Select the workcenter where this state/event occurred. Start typing to search by code or name. This is a required field - every history record must be associated with a workcenter.

fields.label: Mode
fields.description: Select the operational mode during this period. Standard modes include: Production (actively making product), Idle (available but not producing), Maintenance, Setup/Changeover, and Disabled (unavailable/down).

fields.label: State
fields.description: Select the detailed operational state. States provide granular insight into equipment condition: Running, Running Slow, Blocked, Starved, Faulted, Emergency Stop, Maintenance, Offline, etc.

fields.label: Event
fields.description: Select the event or reason code for this state. Events categorize what happened (e.g., maintenance, changeover, breakdown). Start typing to search. Leave blank if no specific event applies.

fields.label: Work Order
fields.description: Select the work order active during this period. This links the state to production context for work order-level analysis. Leave blank during non-production periods.

fields.label: Schedule
fields.description: Select the production schedule or shift. This enables shift-level reporting and comparisons. Leave blank if schedule tracking is not required.

fields.label: Duration (minutes)
fields.description: Duration in minutes. This is typically auto-calculated from Occur At and End At, but can be manually entered or overridden if needed. Enter decimal values for partial minutes (e.g., 45.5).

fields.label: Notes
fields.description: Enter any additional comments, observations, or context about this state/event. Include root cause information, actions taken, or follow-up items. This field is searchable for later reference.

dataTransform.transform:
[edges.node~>|$|{
  "workOrderDisplay": workOrder.code ? workOrder.code : "No Work Order",
  "eventDisplay": event.name ? event.name : (event.code ? event.code : "No Event"),
  "eventCategoryDisplay": event.eventCategory.name ? event.eventCategory.name : "Uncategorized",
  "scheduleDisplay": schedule.code ? schedule.code : "No Schedule",
  "createdByDisplay": createdByUser.firstName & ' ' & createdByUser.lastName,
  "modeColor": (
    $modeColors := {"Production": "#2e7d32", "production": "#2e7d32", "Idle": "#ed6c02", "idle": "#ed6c02", "disabled": "#d32f2f", "Disabled": "#d32f2f"};
    $lookup($modeColors, modeId) ? $lookup($modeColors, modeId) : "#757575"
  ),
  "stateColor": (
    $stateColors := {
      "running": "#2e7d32", "Running": "#2e7d32", "RUN": "#2e7d32",
      "running-slow": "#ff9800", "Running Slow": "#ff9800", "SLOW": "#ff9800",
      "stopped": "#ed6c02", "Stopped": "#ed6c02", "STOP": "#ed6c02",
      "blocked": "#f57c00", "Blocked": "#f57c00", "BLKD": "#f57c00",
      "starved": "#ff9800", "Starved": "#ff9800", "STRV": "#ff9800",
      "held": "#ed6c02", "Held": "#ed6c02", "HELD": "#ed6c02",
      "faulted": "#d32f2f", "Faulted": "#d32f2f", "FLT": "#d32f2f",
      "e-stopped": "#d32f2f", "Emergency Stop": "#d32f2f", "ESTOP": "#d32f2f",
      "changeover": "#1976d2", "Changeover": "#1976d2", "CHGV": "#1976d2",
      "warmup": "#1976d2", "Warming Up": "#1976d2", "WARM": "#1976d2",
      "cleaning": "#1976d2", "Cleaning": "#1976d2", "CLN": "#1976d2",
      "maintenance": "#7b1fa2", "Under Maintenance": "#7b1fa2", "MAINT": "#7b1fa2",
      "offline": "#757575", "Offline": "#757575", "OFF": "#757575",
      "unknown": "#757575", "Unknown": "#757575", "UNK": "#757575"
    };
    $lookup($stateColors, stateId) ? $lookup($stateColors, stateId) : "#757575"
  )
}|]

props.description:
Workcenter History tracks all operational state changes, modes, and events for workcenters over time. Each record represents a discrete time period when a workcenter was in a specific operational state.

**Key Use Cases:**
• OEE Availability Analysis - Track production vs downtime
• Downtime Pareto Analysis - Identify top loss reasons
• State Timeline Visualization - See equipment behavior over time
• Shift Performance Comparison - Compare across schedules

**Data Flow:**
Records are created automatically by equipment integrations or manually by operators. Duration is calculated from occurAt and endAt timestamps. Events and categories enable drill-down analysis.

props.label: Code
props.description:
**`code`** (`String!`)
Unique identifier for this workcenter history record.

- Auto-generated or manually assigned.
- Format: `WCH-{SITE}-{SEQ}` (e.g., `WCH-DET-00001`).
- Used for audit trails and record lookups.

props.label: Occur At
props.description:
**`occurAt`** (`DateTime!`)
Timestamp when this operational state or event began.

- Critical for duration calculations and timeline analysis.
- Used in OEE availability calculations.
- Timezone-aware display based on user settings.

props.label: End At
props.description:
**`endAt`** (`DateTime`)
Timestamp when this operational state or event ended.

- Null if state is still active/ongoing.
- Used with occurAt to calculate duration.
- Essential for closed-loop state tracking.

props.label: Workcenter
props.description:
**`workcenter.code`** (`String!`)
The workcenter where this state/event occurred.

- Links to Workcenter master data.
- Required field - every history record must have a workcenter.
- Example: `WC-PRESS-01`, `WC-FILL-A`.

props.label: Mode
props.description:
**`modeId`** (`String`)
Operational mode of the workcenter during this period.

**ISA-101 Color Coding:**
• 🟢 **Production** (Green #2e7d32) - Active manufacturing
• 🟡 **Idle** (Amber #ed6c02) - Standby, available
• 🔴 **Disabled** (Red #d32f2f) - Unavailable, down

Mode determines OEE Availability calculation.

props.label: State
props.description:
**`stateId`** (`String`)
Detailed operational state within the current mode.

**ISA-101 Color Coding:**
• 🟢 **running** (Green) - Normal production
• 🟠 **running-slow** (Orange) - Producing with performance loss
• 🟠 **blocked** (Orange) - Downstream constraint
• 🟠 **starved** (Orange) - Upstream constraint
• 🟡 **stopped** (Amber) - Not producing, no fault
• 🟡 **held** (Amber) - Production hold
• 🔴 **faulted** (Red) - Equipment fault
• 🔴 **e-stopped** (Red) - Emergency stop
• 🔵 **changeover** (Blue) - Product changeover
• 🔵 **warmup** (Blue) - Equipment warming up
• 🔵 **cleaning** (Blue) - Cleaning cycle
• 🟣 **maintenance** (Purple) - Under maintenance
• ⚫ **offline/unknown** (Gray) - Unavailable or unknown

States drive OEE Performance and Availability analysis.

props.label: Event
props.description:
**`event.name`** (`String`)
Specific event or reason code for this state.

- Links to Event master data.
- Examples: `Scheduled Maintenance`, `Tool Change`, `Material Shortage`.
- Required for downtime analysis and Pareto charts.
- Displays 'No Event' when not applicable.

props.label: Event Category
props.description:
**`event.eventCategory.name`** (`String`)
High-level classification of the event.

- Groups events for reporting (e.g., Planned vs Unplanned).
- Examples: `Planned Downtime`, `Unplanned Downtime`, `Setup`, `Changeover`.
- Affects OEE calculations based on `affectsOee` flag.
- Displays 'Uncategorized' when not set.

props.label: Duration
props.description:
**`duration`** (`Duration`)
Calculated duration of this state period.

- Computed from occurAt and endAt timestamps.
- Displayed in abbreviated format (e.g., `45m`, `2h 30m`).
- Used for downtime totals and OEE calculations.
- Null/N/A if state is still active.

props.label: Schedule
props.description:
**`schedule.code`** (`String`)
Production schedule or shift during this period.

- Links to Schedule master data.
- Examples: `First`, `Second`, `Third`, `Weekend`.
- Enables shift-level performance analysis.
- Displays 'No Schedule' when not assigned.

props.label: Notes
props.description:
**`notes`** (`String`)
Free-text comments or observations.

- Operator-entered context about the state/event.
- May include root cause notes, actions taken, or follow-up items.
- Searchable for incident investigation.

props.label: Created At
props.description:
**`createdAt`** (`DateTime!`)
System timestamp when this record was created.

- Auto-populated by the system.
- Used for audit trails and data integrity.
- Cannot be modified after creation.

props.label: Created By
props.description:
**`createdByUser`** (`User!`)
User who created this record.

- Auto-populated based on logged-in user.
- Displays full name (First Last).
- Used for accountability and audit trails.
